557:t_111:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then what will you do if something you don't like happens in that world!?」

557:t_111:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Don't think someone who whines about every little thing in the past can accomplish anything!」

557:t_111:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「My drill will punch through your rotten spirit and your plan!!」

557:t_112:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'll teach you! People have a present because they have a past, and that's how they can move toward the future!」

557:t_112:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「I have no interest in a trite sermon. I'm simply correcting mistakes.」

557:t_112:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then I'm doing the same! I'll end your mistaken plan here!」

557:t_112:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Killing people all over the world to ease your own sorrow could never be right!」

557:t_113:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Enough with your selfish logic! If you don't like this world, you leave it!」

557:t_113:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「I can't do that. I want to live, too.」

557:t_113:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then how can you stand by and let other people's lives be lost!?」

557:t_113:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「In the end, what you're trying to do is nothing but selfishness!!」

557:t_114:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Stop your futile resistance and surrender at once!」

557:t_114:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Stop your futile resistance and surrender at once!」

557:t_114:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Stop your futile resistance and surrender at once!」

557:t_114:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Sorry, but I have no intention of listening to an android.」

557:t_114:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ isn't human, but $$ノノ$$ is alive! And $$ノノ$$ won't stand by while someone's selfishness takes lives!」

557:t_114:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ isn't human, but $$ノノ$$ is alive! And $$ノノ$$ won't stand by while someone's selfishness takes lives!」

557:t_114:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ isn't human, but $$ノノ$$ is alive! And $$ノノ$$ won't stand by while someone's selfishness takes lives!」

557:t_114:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「Because you're a hero of justice...?」

557:t_114:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No! Protecting another's life is only natural for beings who live in the same world!」

557:t_114:12.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「No! Protecting another's life is only natural for beings who live in the same world!」

557:t_114:13.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「No! Protecting another's life is only natural for beings who live in the same world!」

557:t_115:2.en:
$$葵$$
「If you thought I'd say that, you're dead wrong. I have no interest in understanding a coward who thinks he's the only one who's been hurt.」

557:t_115:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Quite the talker. As expected of an heir to the blood of the beast, ruled by primal instinct.」

557:t_115:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Clearly, the only way to subdue a beast is through force.」

557:t_115:5.en:
$$葵$$
「I prefer that to your pretty-boy act.」

557:t_115:6.en:
$$葵$$
「Then I won't hold back! I'll smash your plan here!」

557:t_116:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Now that the boss has come out, we've got this! All we have to do is stop you and end this plan!」

557:t_116:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Just like a salaryman. Your petty desire to maintain the status quo is contemptible.」

557:t_116:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't pigeonhole me! Unlike you, I simply value life!」

557:t_116:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「I don't care if you're a $$ウィスパード$$ or a genius. I won't let someone who kills hardworking people for selfish reasons have his way with the world!」

557:t_116:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Here I come! Learn the true strength of the salarymen you mocked!」

557:t_117:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What a shame. If we'd had more time, I could have debated the meaning of past and future with you.」

557:t_117:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「I agree. It would have been time well spent.」

557:t_117:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even this brief exchange has shown me that you haven't the slightest intention of listening to others.」

557:t_117:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Your elegant manner hides it, but you're every bit as self-important as the vulgar villains I despise.」

557:t_117:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I've realized something, too. I would surely have gained nothing from debating you.」

557:t_117:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then, reluctantly, I shall stop you by force.」

557:t_117:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「For this ugly yet lovable world...!」

557:t_118:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even you, beings who change the world's natural order, reject what I'm doing?」

557:t_118:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Of course! How could we silently watch countless lives be lost!?」

557:t_118:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「As expected of someone who sacrificed himself as a pillar for the world. I can't understand that spirit of self-sacrifice.」

557:t_118:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm not asking you to! I'm going to punch you and protect the lives in this world!」

557:t_119:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Can't you see!? There are people doing their best to live in this world!」

557:t_119:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「They can live in the new world we create.」

557:t_119:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「There's nothing new about it! It's a world where you selfishly rewrote the past!」

557:t_119:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't accept it! I won't hand the history $$ミコノ$$ and I have lived through to someone like you!」

557:t_120:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I know, $$碇シンジ$$. You live in regret and wish to redo the world.」

557:t_120:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's not too late. Come to me with that spear, and I'll help you atone.」

557:t_120:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...But that would... take the lives of the people living in this world now...」

557:t_120:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll take responsibility for that. You needn't worry.」

557:t_120:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then you choose to live in regret? Without atoning for the lives you've taken?」

557:t_120:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But...! I can't believe your way is right...!」

557:t_120:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll find my own way...! After stopping you here...!」

557:t_121:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I know about you, too, $$ガロード・ラン$$.」

557:t_121:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I've really become famous! Even villains know my name!」

557:t_121:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you join me with that $$ガンダム$$, I could prepare a world where you and $$ティファ・アディール$$ live happily.」

557:t_121:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course, we'd make it so she never had that power.」

557:t_121:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...You don't understand $$ティファ$$ at all!」

557:t_121:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's true her $$ニュータイプ$$ powers have made her suffer...!」

557:t_121:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But now she's accepted them and is moving toward the future! I won't fall for the smooth talk of someone who doesn't understand that!」

557:t_122:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Stop the plan right now! Do you understand what the consequences of your actions will be!?」

557:t_122:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course. But that's nothing to mourn.」

557:t_122:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Everyone can live happily in the new world, and the Empire will be driven out of this one.」

557:t_122:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We're not fighting just to defeat the Empire! We want to protect the people living in this world!」

557:t_122:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Someone who doesn't understand that has no right to move the world!」

557:t_123:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$... I know you're tormented by wounds from the past, too.」

557:t_123:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But what I gained from them made me stronger and gave me the strength to move beyond them.」

557:t_123:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「You think this world has a future?」

557:t_123:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To find out, we can't let the world end here...!」
